title: Design: Modern invoice that pays for itself prints no band
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer B with no saved Bill Invoices To, so the customer bills itself.
  • Have a new work order for this test for customer B billing itself, invoiced.
  • Set the document design to modern (Settings, invoice and estimate design).
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p4-18-after-modern-pays-for-itself.png, bt-p4-17-before-modern-pays-for-itself.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Click the print icon on the Finance tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Finance tab shows the invoice.

Step 2:

  • No SERVICE FOR band prints; the asset row follows the ADDRESSES box directly, as in production.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12310 (Story 8, "Service For" band on invoices and estimates)

  • S8-N1: “When the customer pays for itself, no band prints and the document is unchanged.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "4 Service For band on invoices and estimates", pictures "Modern, pays for itself" (This build), "Modern, pays for itself" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).
